newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Two Arab channels to broadcast in Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: Two Arab channels to broadcast in Tunisia.

text.p: Tunisian state-run radio and television has signed an agreement to allow two Arab channels to broadcast in the country in return for broadcasting its own programmes abroad, the official TAP news agency said.
Orbit, the Saudi-owned relay station based in Rome, and Arab Radio Television ART, plan to install and use a distribution network to broadcast in Tunisia, TAP said.
Orbit and ART will air cultural and sports programmes and in return will broadcast Tunisian TV programmes in the Gulf and Latin American countries.
A Tunisian state-controlled firm will be created to supervise their activities, TAP added.
The deals were signed on Wednesday in Tunisia by Information Secretary of State Fethi Houidi, Salah Abdallah representing ART and Orbit's Vice-President James Garner.
